# Synthetic task courses

Each folder has a learner-facing `.prax` lesson, its `course.yaml`, a schema 1 `inspect.json` generated by Studio's `praxity inspect <folder> --schema 1`, separate `context.md` with author intent, a hand-coded `answer.json`, and a frozen `baseline-report.json` from Trace with `--tasks`. The frozen reports omit the retired Page similarity field and the separate objectives guide. The source text is original synthetic material. Awareness's remote video and map URLs are inert placeholders; Judgment links a local slider model.

The [coding guide](../../../docs/task-coding-guide.md) records each contrast, expected reading, legitimate alternative, block ref and source line. These baselines precede independent designer coding. The next review should record both designers' assignments and disagreements without replacing the frozen answers.

The saved answers and baseline reports retain their historical prompt version and course fingerprint. They are stale under the transcript-channel contract and are not accepted as current model answers. Interface tests assert their rejection, then construct explicitly synthetic current payloads from the preserved coding and revalidate every quoted span. No new model review is implied.
